Markets.title: Nike targets $5 billion more in revenue growth by 2031 in latest turnaround push
Markets.summary: Nike has announced a plan to generate an additional $5 billion in revenue by fiscal 2031 under CEO Elliott Hill. The turnaround strategy focuses on prioritizing five key performance sports and strategic countries to return the company to revenue growth by fiscal 2029.

Markets.title: Signature Global-led consortium buys 194 acre land via auction for Rs 194 cr
Markets.summary: A Signature Global-led consortium acquired 474.66 acres of land in Raigad, Maharashtra, through an auction for Rs 194 crore. This purchase marks the company's expansion beyond the Delhi-NCR market into the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

Markets.title: Sebi lowers margin requirements for agri-derivatives contracts
Markets.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India lowered the initial margin requirements for agricultural derivatives contracts to between 6% and 10%. Effective December 1 for a one-year period, this change aligns agricultural commodity margins with those of non-agricultural commodities like metals.

Markets.title: BP launches offer to buy back up to $6 billion of bonds
Markets.summary: BP is launching a plan to buy back up to $6 billion of its bonds maturing between 2027 and 2034. CEO Meg O'Neill stated the move is designed to improve cash management and maintain a disciplined balance sheet amid oil price volatility.

Markets.title: K Raheja Corp inks joint development agreement for 165-acre township in Mumbai region
Markets.summary: K Raheja Corp has signed a joint development agreement for a 165-acre land parcel in Panvel within the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The landowners and K Raheja Corp will share the revenue from this township project, which has a land value of approximately Rs 956 crore.

Markets.title: BlackRock raises its stake in Axis Bank to 5%
Markets.summary: BlackRock has increased its stake in Axis Bank to 5 percent by purchasing additional shares on the open market. This acquisition raises the investment firm's total ownership to over 155 million shares.

Geo-Political.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: Ukraine executed a planned missile and drone attack that partially collapsed the strategic bridge in Russian-annexed Crimea. President Volodymyr Zelensky hailed the operation as an unprecedented success.

Geo-Political.title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him
Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated he would be honoured to return to his role if the board requested it. Huang reported receiving numerous calls from investors and others urging him to come back.

Geo-Political.title: 'It was really scary': Mother describes sheltering during Russia strikes on Kyiv bridge
Geo-Political.summary: Moscow recently launched strikes targeting bridges in Kyiv, terrifying local residents seeking shelter. Meanwhile, Ukrainian forces severely damaged a critical bridge connecting Russia to occupied Crimea.

Geo-Political.title: Russian military plane crashes killing all 19 on board
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian military plane crashed in the Kemerovo region, killing all 19 people on board. The Russian defence ministry preliminarily attributes the incident to a technical malfunction.

Geo-Political.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
Geo-Political.summary: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool designed to reverse engineer applications without requiring access to their source code. The tool allows users to understand how app features and mechanics work through evidence-backed AI answers, eliminating the need to read assembly code.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization in 2025.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: This guide outlines ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These applications help digital creators streamline their workflows and maintain a competitive edge in an evolving landscape.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire is an AI content generation platform that helps users create digital media. The platform also provides tools for creators to share and monetize their work.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools used across various industries to automate repetitive tasks and boost productivity. These widely adopted technologies are designed to improve workflow efficiency for a variety of applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This article evaluates the top 10 AI content generator and writer tools available in 2022. It aims to help readers choose the right software to create effective, efficient, and engaging content for their audiences.

Data & Insights.title: Could AI boom trigger a jobs crisis? The risks Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sees beyond productivity gains
Data & Insights.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh warns that the AI boom could cause widespread job displacement through automation. Alternatively, he notes it might drive economic growth via productivity or trigger a slowdown if market expectations are unmet.

Data & Insights.title: Union Budget 2027-28: FICCI seeks graded LTCG taxation,  ₹100 lakh crore in credit for manufacturing growth
Data & Insights.summary: FICCI has recommended restoring the long-term capital gains tax exemption on listed securities for the Union Budget 2027-28. The industry body is also advocating for a calibrated increase in the securities transaction tax.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: What FM's pre-budget stakeholder consultations mean
Data & Insights.summary: Finance minister Nirmala Sitharaman is meeting with various stakeholders, including industry executives, bankers, and for the first time, young people and retired bureaucrats. These pre-budget consultations will take place over the next few days to gather diverse perspectives.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027: Economists oppose LTCG tax cut as industry seeks abolition; what they told Sitharaman
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of Budget 2027-28, economists advised Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman to retain the Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) tax on equities. This recommendation directly opposes the corporate sector's demand for the complete abolition of the tax.

Data & Insights.title: Budget 2027-28: Govt to invite Gen Z for pre-Budget consultations; Sitharaman meets economists
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman has started pre-Budget consultations with economists for the Union Budget 2027-28. The government will also gather policy inputs from Gen Z, industry leaders, trade unions, and state governments.

Data & Insights.title: Centre hikes windfall tax on diesel, ATF exports; petrol levy unchanged — Check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has increased the windfall tax on exports of diesel and Aviation Turbine Fuel (ATF). Meanwhile, the export levy on petrol remains unchanged following the previous revision on October 31.

India.title: Elderly Couple, Student Killed In Road Accidents In UP: Cops
India.summary: An elderly couple and a student were killed in separate road accidents in Uttar Pradesh. The couple died after a speeding truck hit their motorcycle on National Highway-19.

India.title: AI Agents Could Displace About 10% Of Workers In 5 Years: IBM Chief To NDTV
India.summary: IBM CEO Arvind Krishna stated that artificial intelligence agents could displace about 10% of workers within five years. However, he noted that AI will also create different types of jobs and currently contributes substantially in three key areas.

India.title: Punjab Government Delaying Stay On Anti-Sacrilege Bill: Akal Takht Panel
India.summary: The Akal Takht committee stated that the Punjab government is delaying a stay on the anti-sacrilege bill. The panel reiterated that the government must provide clear answers to two questions raised on November 14.

India.title: 'Ask Your Father': Union Minister To Tejashwi Yadav Over Nitish Setu Remark
India.summary: Union Minister Lalan Singh criticized the 15-year governance of former Bihar Chief Ministers Lalu Prasad Yadav and Rabri Devi. He told RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav to ask his father about the development work done during that period.

India.title: "Must End": India Condemns Hormuz Tanker Attack After Indian Goes Missing
India.summary: India condemned a tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz after an Indian national went missing during the incident. The Indian Embassy in Oman is closely coordinating with local authorities to monitor ongoing search and rescue operations.

India.title: Man Dies After Allegedly Eating Sweet Near Mumbai, Food Poisoning Suspected
India.summary: A man died of suspected food poisoning near Mumbai after allegedly eating a sweet. Food authorities have sealed the shop and seized over Rs 4.58 lakh worth of stock.

General.title: Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'
General.summary: The government is supporting former minister Alan Milburn's plans to reform the welfare system. The proposal shifts government spending away from benefits and redirects it toward increased job support to prevent a lost generation.

General.title: 'Can I really do this?': Neets speak to BBC about struggling to get a job
General.summary: A government-backed review has proposed new measures to help young people find employment. Meanwhile, young people known as Neets have spoken to the BBC about the struggles they face in getting a job.

General.title: Jensen Huang says he would be 'honoured' to return as Nvidia CEO if board asked him
General.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that he would be honored to return to his role if the board asked him. He reported receiving numerous calls from investors and others urging him to come back.

General.title: American soldier arrested by UK police on suspicion of spying taken into US military custody
General.summary: British police arrested an American soldier on suspicion of espionage and national security violations. The U.S. military subsequently took the soldier into its custody.

General.title: Putin's Crimean Bridge partly collapses as Zelensky hails 'unprecedented' attack by Ukraine
General.summary: A Ukrainian missile and drone attack partially collapsed the strategic bridge in Russian-annexed Crimea. President Volodymyr Zelensky hailed the operation, which Ukraine stated took weeks to plan.

General.title: BBC reports from Kyiv bridge hit by Russian attack
General.summary: BBC reporter Sarah Rainsford visited a bridge in Kyiv that was hit by an overnight Russian attack. She spoke with residents living near the strike site about the incident.
